title: CSPS Context Bundle
description: The typed contract every AI-to-AI spawn must satisfy. All fields are load-bearing: missing any REQUIRED field = BLOCKING pre-spawn. FORBIDDEN: navigation refs ('see §', '../'), relative paths in inline_critical_content. B_BOUNDARY_CONTRACT S088.

governing_intent.description: WHY this spawn exists — one precise sentence. Must NOT contain 'see §', '../', or 'refer to'. Must be self-contained.

DoD.description: Definition of Done — measurable, verifiable criteria and the evidence that proves each one.

items.description: One verifiable done criterion. Must be testable (exit_code=0, file exists, validator PASS, etc.).

criterion_ref.description: 0-based index into DoD.criteria this evidence satisfies.

proof_spec.description: The specific check. e.g. 'node tools/validators/validate-X.mjs → blocking=0', 'git log --oneline -1 | grep [sha]'.

block_test.description: Behavioral block-test spec: the gate MUST go RED on a planted defect.

planted_defect.description: What is planted to trigger the gate (e.g. 'remove tenant_id field').

expected_exit.description: Expected exit code when defect is planted. Must be 1 (blocking).

test_file.description: Absolute path from repo root to the behavioral test script.

inline_critical_content.description: Content that MUST be pasted inline (no navigation refs). Zero-Context-Assumption: receiver starts with nothing.

path.description: Absolute repo path to the file. FORBIDDEN: relative paths ('../../', '../'). Must start without '..'.

content.description: The file content, verbatim. Never a reference — the content itself.

items.description: A key decision the receiver needs. No 'see §' — the decision, inline.

read_allowlist.description: Absolute paths the spawned agent is allowed to READ. Must be explicit — no wildcards unless scoped.

items.description: Absolute path or path prefix (e.g. 'tools/data/', 'docs/plan/'). Must NOT start with '../../'.

write_allowlist.description: Absolute paths the spawned agent is allowed to WRITE/EDIT. Minimal — only what the task requires.

items.description: Absolute path or narrow path prefix.

head_sha.description: Git HEAD SHA at the moment of spawn. Ensures the agent works on the correct tree.

session_id.description: Current CSPS session ID (e.g. S088). Used for audit trail and rate-limiting.

tenant_id.description: Tenant identifier. Required for multi-tenant isolation. Use 'platform' for platform-level work.

budget.description: Resource limits for the spawned agent. All four fields required — no implicit inheritance.

tool_calls.description: Maximum number of tool calls allowed.

wall_clock_seconds.description: Wall-clock timeout in seconds. Agent must complete within this window.

cost_usd.description: Maximum estimated cost in USD. Spawn aborted if projected cost exceeds this.

challenge_clause.description: What the spawned agent should actively verify or push back on (Grok's 'understanding test'). Forces confirmation the agent understood the intent, not just the instructions.

output_contract.description: What the spawned agent MUST return. Used by the receiver to validate the output before use.

format.description: Output format. The receiver validates against this.

items.description: Field or section that MUST appear in the output.
Patterns that MUST NOT appear in the output (e.g. 'see §', 'as I mentioned', relative paths).
